summary: Ridgepost Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of all equity interests of Stellus Capital Management, LLC for $125M cash plus 11,191,149 Ridgepost LLC units and 579,096 shares of its Class A Common Stock. The units are exchangeable into Class A Common Stock on a one-for-one basis, and shares are subject to staggered lock-up restrictions: one-third on the first anniversary, two-thirds on the second, and full on the third. The transaction is governed by a February 4, 2026 purchase agreement. Watch for seller lock-up expirations and potential dilution from unit exchanges.
